# `hash` standard library

The `hash` module provides fast non-cryptographic byte hashing (`fnv1a`, `fnv1a32`,
`wyhash`), checksums (`crc32`, `adler32`), hash combinators (`combine`), and `#!`
compile-time structural hashing (`hash::of`, `hash::seeded`) over arbitrary records,
tuples, enums, options, arrays, slices, and maps.

```{.dva .run}
#use hash
#use io
#use str

#type Point (x: Int, y: Int)

io::out $ str::from_int(Int(hash::crc32("123456789")))
io::out $ str::from_int(Int(hash::of(Point(10, 20)) != hash::of(Point(20, 10))))
```

## Function catalog

| Symbol / Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `hash::fnv1a(s)` | `String => u64` | 64-bit FNV-1a hash of the bytes of `s` |
| `hash::fnv1a32(s)` | `String => u32` | 32-bit FNV-1a hash of the bytes of `s` |
| `hash::wyhash(s, seed)` | `String, u64 => u64` | Seeded 64-bit WyHash of the bytes of `s` |
| `hash::crc32(s)` | `String => u32` | IEEE 802.3 CRC-32 checksum (`0xEDB88320` polynomial) |
| `hash::adler32(s)` | `String => u32` | RFC 1950 Adler-32 checksum |
| `hash::combine(h1, h2)` | `u64, u64 => u64` | Mixes two 64-bit hashes into a single 64-bit hash |
| `hash::seeded(seed, val)` | `#! T: Type, u64, T => u64` | Compile-time specialized structural 64-bit hash of `val` with `seed` |
| `hash::of(val)` | `#! T: Type, T => u64` | Compile-time specialized structural 64-bit hash of `val` (`seed = 0`) |
